clues: This town stands on a wide flat plain in the heart of its land. The great Tigris flows through it and cuts the plain in two.
Summers here are extremely hot, long, and dry. Winters are short and mild, with just a little rain.
In the year 762, the caliph al-Mansur founded this city to be his capital. It grew into one of the largest cities in the whole world.
Many tales in a famed book of one thousand and one nights are set in this town. The tales show the town in its grand age of gold.
Iraq is run from this town, where the men and women in charge sit and work. More folk live here than in any other town in the land.
